provenance.note: Transcribed from the official Yamaha AN1x Data List (MIDI Data Format). CC: full MODE2 per-parameter Control Change map (set the AN1x MIDI Control Mode to 2). SysEx parameter change F0 43 1n 5C addr3 data F7 (model 5C, no checksum): System block (00 00 00, complete), Voice Common (10 00 00: name in dump, effects/EQ/arp/free-EG config), Voice Scene 1/2 (10 10 00 / 10 11 00, full synth voice + 16-slot control matrix). Bulk dump F0 43 0n 5C bcMSB bcLSB addr3 data cs F7 with sum-7bit checksum; request F0 43 2n 5C addr3 F7. Full dump receive layouts verified for System and Scene buffers; Voice Common / Scene Ctrl / Step SEQ / User banks are request-only (their bulk-dump-only arrays, e.g. per-step Free EG data, are not transcribed). Device number assumed 0 for dump/request framing. Presets: the Data List's MIDI Implementation Chart marks Bank Select (CC 0 / CC 32) as neither transmitted nor recognized, so voices are selected by Program Change alone (0...127, transmitted and recognized). The 128 factory voice names are the Data List's Factory-set Voice List. The 128 User voices are addressable only by bulk dump (11 00 00...11 7F 00) and have no Program Change of their own, so they are not modelled as a bank: PRESET/USER is a front-panel choice the AN1x does not expose over MIDI.
